title: Sekai no 4-koma
synopsis: Official 4-Koma for the smartphone game Project Sekai Colorful Stage feat. Hatsune Miku.

tags.name: Rock Music
tags.description: Centers on the musical style of rock, not to be applied to anime that use rock in its soundtrack.

tags.name: Long Strip
tags.description: Manga originally published in a vertical, long-strip format, designed for viewing on smartphones. Also known as webtoons.

tags.name: Hip-hop Music
tags.description: Centers on the musical style of hip-hop, not to be applied to anime that use hip-hop in its soundtrack.

tags.name: Restaurant
tags.description: Features a business that prepares and serves food and drinks to customers. Also encompasses cafes and bistros.

tags.name: Tsundere
tags.description: Prominently features a character who acts cold and hostile in order to mask warmer emotions.

tags.name: Parody
tags.description: Features deliberate exaggeration of popular tropes or a particular genre to comedic effect.

tags.name: Ojou-sama
tags.description: Features a wealthy, high-class, oftentimes stuck up and demanding female character.

tags.name: Tomboy
tags.description: Features a girl who exhibits characteristics or behaviors considered in many cultures to be typical of boys.

tags.name: Nekomimi
tags.description: Humanoid characters with cat-like features such as cat ears and a tail.

tags.name: Isekai
tags.description: Features a character from a modern-day setting being transported into an alternate world and has to adapt to their new surroundings.

tags.name: Alternate Universe
tags.description: Features multiple alternate universes in the same series.

tags.name: Chibi
tags.description: Features "super deformed" character designs with smaller, rounder proportions and a cute look.

tags.name: Kemonomimi
tags.description: Prominently features humanoid characters with animal ears.

tags.name: Bar
tags.description: Partly or completely set in a bar.

tags.name: Urban Fantasy
tags.description: Set in a world similar to the real world, but with the existence of magic or other supernatural elements.

tags.name: Archery
tags.description: Centers around the sport of archery, or prominently features the use of archery in combat.

tags.name: Ensemble Cast
tags.description: Features a large cast of characters with (almost) equal screen time and importance to the plot.

tags.name: Vocal Synth
tags.description: Features one or more singers or characters that are products of a synthesize singing program. Popular examples are Vocaloids, UTAUloids, and CeVIOs.

tags.name: Female Protagonist
tags.description: Main character is female.

tags.name: Primarily Female Cast
tags.description: Main cast is mostly composed of female characters.

tags.name: Artificial Intelligence
tags.description: Intelligent non-organic machines that work and react similarly to humans.

tags.name: Band
tags.description: Main cast is a group of musicians.

tags.name: Idol
tags.description: Centers around the life and activities of an idol.

tags.name: Transgender
tags.description: Features a character whose gender identity differs from the sex they were assigned at birth.

tags.name: Cute Girls Doing Cute Things
tags.description: Centers around female characters doing cute activities, usually with little to no emphasis on drama and conflict.

tags.name: Twins
tags.description: Prominently features two or more siblings that were born at one birth.

tags.name: School
tags.description: Partly or completely set in a primary or secondary educational institution.

tags.name: Robots
tags.description: Prominently features humanoid machines.

tags.name: Urban
tags.description: Partly or completely set in a city.

tags.name: Primarily Teen Cast
tags.description: Main cast is mostly composed of teen characters.

tags.name: Acting
tags.description: Centers around actors or the acting industry.

tags.name: 4-koma
tags.description: A manga in the 'yonkoma' format, which consists of four equal-sized panels arranged in a vertical strip.

tags.name: Shrine Maiden
tags.description: Prominently features a character who is a shrine maiden.

tags.name: Video Games
tags.description: Centers around characters playing video games.

tags.name: Ships
tags.description: Prominently features the use of sea-based transportation vessels.
